summary: X Autopilot production activation hardening verification completed. All 35 pytest tests passed. API endpoints verified with correct flags (CATCH_UP_ENABLED=false, TEST_HARD_CAP_ENABLED=false, MOCK_MODE=true). State toggling tested successfully (POST /start with no immediate run, POST /pause). Static code review confirmed real-mode safety: SENDING marker before create, proper error handling (NETWORK_ERROR->UNVERIFIED with readback, DEFINITIVE_ERRORS->FAILED), duplicate prevention, and no catch-up (due_slot skips slots <= activated_at).

next_run: future timestamp in Europe/Rome timezone
POST /start: Returns 200 with CATCH_UP_ENABLED=false, IMMEDIATE_RUN_TRIGGERED=false, activated_at set, next_run future

Static code review: NETWORK_ERROR/API_ERROR -> UNVERIFIED + _readback_recent + advance + slot finished (line 267-279, 288-299)
Static code review: DEFINITIVE_CREATE_ERRORS -> FAILED marker + slot stops (line 273-275, 329-333)
Static code review: PUBLISHED only after _readback_post ok (line 300-314)
Static code review: due_slot skips slots <= activated_at (line 454-455)

POST_start.verification: No immediate run triggered, activated_at persisted, next_run calculated

SENDING_marker_before_create.implementation: await real_runs_col.update_one with status=SENDING before adapter.create_post

NETWORK_ERROR_handling.implementation: Non-definitive errors (timeout/5xx) -> UNVERIFIED status, _readback_recent called, queue advances, slot finishes

DEFINITIVE_ERROR_handling.implementation: DEFINITIVE_CREATE_ERRORS -> FAILED marker, infra=True, slot stops without trying next model

PUBLISHED_after_readback.implementation: _readback_post called before advancing, PUBLISHED only if readback ok=true

no_catch_up.implementation: if activated and s['at'] <= activated: continue (line 454-455)

duplicate_prevention.implementation: Check for existing SENDING/UNVERIFIED/PUBLISHED marker before any write, DUPLICATE_PREVENTED status if found

mock_branch_unchanged.note: Mock logic remains intact, no modifications detected

environment_verification.safety_gates: All gates prevent real writes: mock mode active, real posting disabled, scheduler disabled
environment_verification.production_note: Production deployment will be user-deployed separately with different environment variables
